cookie-modal.paragraph: We use cookies to ensure the smooth operation of the website (essential cookies) and to create services and  offers tailored to your needs (Optional cookies - you must additionally agree to them).
cookie-modal.title: Cookies on ARBER.UA
cookie-modal-setting.title.required-desc: These cookies are necessary for the proper functioning of our online store. They enable us to securely process your order, remember you as a registered user when you navigate to another page, or automatically fill in your address details when placing an order. Blocking these cookies in your browser may cause malfunctions on the website.
cookie-modal-setting.title.analytics-des: Analytical cookies help us understand how you use our online store, identify pages that need improvement, or those that are popular and function correctly. It is important to note that the information collected is anonymous and does not allow us to identify any user.
cookie-modal-setting.title.personalizati: By analyzing your preferences on the website and your choice of brands, we can display personalized product offers, make changes to the website's functionality, and publish sponsored content. Your data may be used to improve existing systems and software, as well as to develop new solutions.
cookie-modal-setting.title.advertising-d: By agreeing to the use of these cookies, you allow us to tailor advertising to your interests. With their help, platforms such as Facebook or Instagram can properly adjust the content displayed, ensuring it is useful and relevant specifically for you.
